name: starbattle
description: 双星 Star Battle — 零猜测双星区域推理. 出题时由铅笔求解器实测：每一局都唯一可解、且只用区域与行列计数就能推到底, 难度分与档位区间都是量出来的.

scripts.check: for f in js/*.js js/*/*.js tools/*.mjs tools/scenarios.js; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node --check server.cjs && node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && echo OK
